title: Much Smaller than I expected !!!
text:
Much Smaller than I expected !!!. [[VIDEOID:9e2fc5b1a523bf6f2eada22aceea8508]] Honestly, I am surprised so many people gave this a 5 star rating!
It is very small. It only holds 5 (medium at best) size pieces of wood.
I got this to carry wood from outside stacked by my ramp leading into the garage.
Literally, just 15 feet away, and I find this doesn’t save me time at all.
In fact, for my purpose kinda useless. I also thought it would help bring wood from garage into house without as much of a mess. But, because it is so small it doesn’t even help with that.
I guess, just realize it won’t hold much at all. Just my honest review, sorry!

product_metadata.title: Log Carrier for Firewood - Waxed Canvas Log Carrier Tote - Heavy Duty Wood Carrier for Fireplace – Best Bag for Carrying Wood at Home or Camping by Outdoor 360 - Firewood Carrier with Handles
features: Carry More Firewood Effortlessly! This canvas log carrier for firewood has open sides, so you can load it up with any length of firewood and it holds up to 10 standard logs with the strap and handles securely tightened, which means less trips to the woodpile and more time relaxing by the fire.

Easy To Use At Home Or Camping! Simply lay the open firewood bag flat, pile in your wood, secure the strap, grab the handle and go. The flat design makes it easy to load any size log- even in the dark, and the ergonomic style removes pressure off your back, arms and shoulders.

Comfortable To Hold And Haul Wood! - The reinforced padded handles make it comfortable to haul in wood without slipping or having your hands and palms pay the price of splinters. The handle is the perfect length to tote the wood bag by your shoulder or below your chest, so you can see where you’re going.

Keeps Dirt And Wood Chips Off You And Your Floors! The curved shape of the wood bag combined with the adjustable fastener and metal buckle secures and straps in your firewood, keeping sawdust, dirt and wood chips in the log bag instead of spilling out for less mess.

Heavy Duty Water Resistant Canvas! This firewood bag is made to last with double stitching and premium hardware for extra strength. The waxed canvas material repels water, so you can carry in snowy logs without getting wet. When not in use, the bag folds flat for out of sight storage.
